Development with AWS Services: Develop code for applications that are hosted on AWS
Use data stores during application development
Security: Implement authentication and authorization mechanisms for applications and AWS services
Implement encryption and manage sensitive data by using AWS services
Identify and mitigate security risks associated with using and integrating AI services into application development
Testing and Deployment: Prepare application artifacts to be deployed to AWS
Implement and automate application testing in AWS environments
Deploy code by using AWS continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) services
Troubleshooting and Optimization: Assist in a root cause analysis
Apply logging, monitoring, and observability best practices
Optimize applications by using AWS services and features

stem_hints: Which solution will meet these requirements?
Which solution will resolve this issue?
How can the developer maintain these environments with the LEAST amount of configuration?
prompt_template:
@options
Give each question between 4 and 6 options. Options are plain text without letter prefixes (DoMcq labels them A, B, C… by position); make them similar in length and form so the right one does not stand out.
Write the real exam's two kinds of item. Most are multiple choice: exactly 4 options and exactly one correct, so `answer` is a single letter. Some are multiple response: 5 or 6 options, two or more of them correct and at least one incorrect, and the stem says how many to choose ("Choose TWO.", "Choose THREE."); `answer` lists every correct letter in ascending order ("BD").
Never use these as an option: "all of the above", "none of the above". Avoid "both A and B" style options too.
